_doc: Hand-authored verdicts for the 10 drawn canary sites (never regenerated by build.py). term_class: specific = a §3.1 term that is not _unspecified and not ancillary equipment; unspecified = a §3.1 _unspecified term; none = no §3.1 term matches the words. Quotes are in document order; check.py re-verifies each against the stored permit text (words in order).

SITE-000814.note: Title V renewal, holder Polynt Composites USA, Inc (Atlas legal_name of the organization; 'Cook Composites & Polymers Co' is a trade name there).

quotes.quote: Title V renewal for a paint and coatings manufacturing facility
quotes.map_note: 'manufacturing' of paint/coatings = makes it (§3.1 coating_formulation); unit headings are 'Process 1 - 20X Area' etc. with '100 HP Mixer', which name no §3.1 process

SITE-001530.note: Holder renamed between permits (TREMCO INC. - MAMECO DIVISION in 2021, TREMCO CPG INC. - MAMECO in 2023); the 2023 name equals the Atlas legal name. Permit face expiry 2026-09-13 is before today (2026-11-18); no later permit listed.

quotes.quote: BLENDING AND STORAGE OF POLYURETHANE COATINGS
quotes.map_note: blending coatings in kettles with raw materials added and finished product pumped to pails = makes coatings

quotes.quote: FEPTIO renewal for blending vessels with powder dryers for the production of coatings and adhesives
quotes.map_note: 'production of coatings and adhesives'; 'adhesives' alone does not state sealants, adhesive_sealant_formulation is the only adhesive formulation term

SITE-000248.note: Three final permits (P0131913, P0131830, P0133197) together list K001-K005, all the same description.

quotes.quote: K001 Polyester gelcoat and FRP (fiberglass reinforced plastic parts) spray up booth
quotes.map_note: spray-up is not hand lay-up in the regulator's own tables (see SITE-000238, where Hand Lay-Up and Chopper Booth spray-up are separate units); no §3.1 term states spray-up open molding. Vocabulary gap, held for an owner ruling; composites_hand_layup would be a broader/inexact reading

SITE-000238.note: Face expiry of P0105759 is 2024-04-08, before today; no later permit listed in the portal. P0127661 (2019, chopper booth #3) is the newest document.

SITE-001833.note: P0137654 (2025-02-04, to 2030-02-04) renewed; P0136498 (2025-03-28) is an administrative modification for the same two lines.

quotes.quote: Polymer Concrete Extruder Line 1 (Automated Casting Line)
quotes.map_note: 'extruder' without a stated extrusion type = extrusion_unspecified; the line is called a casting line and makes polymer concrete, so what the extrusion shapes is not stated. Judgment-call; not counted as a specific hit

SITE-000140.note: P0140000 effective 2026-06-10 to 2031-06-10; newest permit listed (a draft of the same permit precedes it).

quotes.quote: FEPTIO renewal permit for the expanded polyethylene (EPE) foam extrusion line (P027)
quotes.map_note: expanded polyethylene foam extrusion line = foam_extrusion; unit heading is 'EPE Foam Extrusion Line'

SITE-000535.note: Title V P0134435 effective 2024-03-26 to 2029-03-26. The Atlas site row has no street; the permit's street equals the ECHO exporter street for the linked FRS record.

quotes.quote: Compression mold press #1 of thermoset, fiberglass reinforced composite plastic parts
quotes.map_note: compression mold press = compression_molding; SMC/BMC is not stated so composites_compression_smc_bmc is not used

quotes.quote: Continuous fiberglass laminating operation including, but not limited to: propeller mixer, saturating pans, squeeze rolls, electric ovens, conveyor, edge trim slitter and shear

SITE-000601.note: P0127863 (2020, face expiry 2025-04-01) is the permit that describes the coating lines; P0140443 (2026-08-20) is a later permit for the mixers and vat drying and also refers to the controlled coating lines. Whether the coating lines are still operated is not settled by either.

quotes.quote: the amount of each HAP-containing material applied in the controlled coating lines
quotes.map_note: corroborates coating lines in the 2026 permit

quotes.quote: decorative laminates manufacturing for airplane interiors. Facility consists of coating lines, silkscreen printing, mixers, and vat drying
quotes.map_note: coating lines = coating_applying; silkscreen printing is not mapped to printing_decorating_plastics because the substrate is not stated to be plastic; 'laminates manufacturing' is not mapped to laminating without a stated laminating operation

SITE-000997.note: PTIO P0135320 effective 2024-07-15 to 2034-07-15. The units are epoxy dip stations; nothing in the permit says the coated parts or the coatings are polymer products beyond the epoxy.

quotes.quote: Renewal PTIO for two miscellaneous metal parts coating lines at an electromagnetic coil manufacturing plant
quotes.map_note: metal-parts coating lines = coating_applying; polymer relevance rests on the Atlas NAICS/ring, not on the permit
